title: The Ledger of the Fens
author: Sable Okonkwo
blurb: Wren Okafor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
